description: This file defines functions and types for handling system run plans, including path validation, command resolution, and approval workflows for executing scripts and commands securely within a system. It manages approval snapshots, path canonicalization, and command parsing for various runtime environments like Node.js, Python, Ruby, and package managers like pnpm, npm, and bun.

classes.name: ApprovedCwdSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of an approved current working directory, including its path and filesystem stats.

methods.name: resolveMutableFileOperandSnapshotSync
methods.description: Resolves and validates a mutable file operand for system execution approval, returning a snapshot with path and hash if valid.

methods.name: revalidateApprovedCwdSnapshot
methods.description: Checks if the current working directory matches the previously approved snapshot.

methods.name: revalidateApprovedMutableFileOperand
methods.description: Verifies if a mutable file operand's current state matches the approved snapshot.

methods.name: hardenApprovedExecutionPaths
methods.description: Secures execution paths and arguments based on approval policies, including path validation and executable pinning.

methods.name: buildSystemRunApprovalPlan
methods.description: Constructs an approval plan for executing a system command, including path validation and mutable operand resolution.
